notes: Period is August 2026 preliminary, not July. YoY compares August 2025, not prior month.

Sales are nominal monetary receipts before expenses, inclusive of indirect taxes; no deflation or volume adjustment is stated. The term nominal is interpretation of the monetary definition, not a printed table label.

Business persons are people actually working in establishments/enterprises, excluding dispatched-out and including received-in people; not users/customers. Industry classification differs between sales and people.
2025 January survey integration and sampling/population change require time-series caution. Pre-2025 levels adjusted retrospectively, including consumption-tax treatment.
Values rounded; component sums need not equal totals. p marks preliminary values.
